podcast.body: The music video for Korn's song "Freak on a Leash" was directed by cartoonist Todd McFarland. The video successfully transformed an aggressive, polarizing new metal song into a Grammy Award winner, demonstrating the power of music videos. Its immense popularity led MTV to permanently retire it from their show "Total Request Live." "The result took an aggressive, polarizing new metal song, and turned it into a Grammy Award winner."
